requirement:
During report conversion, on a terminal enabled under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.processes.progress.terminal`, Habeas MUST
display updating progress with elapsed time and completed and total
test-attempt counts. The total MUST count the recorded attempts selected for
conversion. An attempt MUST advance the completed count only after its
conversion has finished or reported a collection failure, including processing
its associated child-process profiles. These counts MUST measure conversion
work regardless of the attempt's test outcome.
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover every obligation in `requirements.test-coverage.processes.progress`. The terminal-enabling rules belong to the cited `requirements.test-coverage.processes.progress.terminal` and are not reassessed here.

**Updating progress with elapsed time and completed/total counts**
- `src/execution_coverage/progress.rs#mod[tests]/fn[stage_and_conversion_counts_are_visible_then_cleared]` builds a conversion `Progress` for totals 0 and 2.
- It asserts the bar position is 0 at the start and equals the expected count after each `completed()` call.
- It asserts the drawn text contains `"{expected}/{total} attempts"` and `"[00:00:"`, the elapsed-time field. It also asserts the text has no color sequences.
- It asserts the display is cleared on drop, for the empty case too.
- `tests/execution_coverage.rs#fn[coverage_progress_on_a_pty_preserves_reports_and_plain_output_policy]` runs the real binary on a PTY with `TERM=xterm`. It asserts the output contains "Converting coverage", "1/1 attempts", "[00:", and in-place update escape sequences. It also asserts that `\x1b[2K` clears the display before "Coverage retained in".

**Total counts the recorded attempts selected for conversion**
- In `src/execution_coverage/runner.rs#fn[finish]`, the total is `attempts.len()`. The attempts are filtered to the current run and exclude pending ones.
- The PTY test reuses one fixture across many runs. `assert_conversion_cleared` does an `rfind("1/1 attempts").unwrap()`, so it would panic if the total included earlier runs' attempts.
- The unit test checks total 2 and total 0.
- Nothing tests that pending attempts are excluded. The requirement does not spell out that exclusion, so I don't count it as a gap.

**Completion advances only after conversion finishes or reports a collection failure**
- `src/execution_coverage/runner.rs#mod[tests]/fn[parallel_conversion_is_bounded_and_retains_every_result_in_order]` drives `parallel_collect` with a work closure that sets a `finished[index]` flag. The completion callback asserts that flag, with the message "progress advanced before conversion finished".
- The same test makes index 3 return `Err("unreadable profile")` and asserts `completed == total`, so a failed conversion still advances the count.
- It runs with 2 and 8 workers and asserts every item is visited exactly once.
- In `fn[finish]`, `finish_attempt` runs inside the work closure and `progress.completed()` runs in the completion callback, so child-process profile processing happens before the count advances.
- The PTY test covers `test(child_process)` with 2 processes and expects a "1/1 attempts" display that is then cleared.

**Counts measure conversion work regardless of test outcome**
- The PTY test runs a passing test, `deliberate_failure` (outcome "failed", exit failure) and `missing_profile` (a collection failure with 0 processes). Each case runs `assert_conversion_cleared`, which requires the "1/1 attempts" count.
- The `missing_profile` case also asserts the "partial profiles and reports have been retained" diagnostic.
- The runner test's `Err` case covers the same point at the helper level.

The remaining wiring, `Progress::conversion(attempts.len())` and `|_| progress.completed()`, is pass-through. The PTY end-to-end runs exercise it anyway.

I found no unacknowledged gap.

text: During report conversion, on a terminal enabled under
display updating progress with elapsed time and completed and total
test-attempt counts. The total MUST count the recorded attempts selected for
conversion. An attempt MUST advance the completed count only after its
conversion has finished or reported a collection failure, including processing
its associated child-process profiles. These counts MUST measure conversion
work regardless of the attempt's test outcome.
Habeas coverage progress MUST be displayed when stderr is an interactive
terminal and `TERM` is not `dumb`. `NO_COLOR` MUST disable color without
disabling progress. When stderr is redirected or `TERM=dumb`, Habeas coverage
progress MUST NOT emit animation or terminal control sequences.
Temporary progress displays MUST be cleared when their stage ends, including
empty work and early collection failures. Final diagnostics and the coverage
artifact location MUST remain readable. Progress reporting MUST NOT change
coverage results, retained profiles, or command exit status.
